research_questions: Can the engineering fixture recover the injected native-script match direction without being presented as research evidence?
Can visual and Han-style claims be withheld when the upstream fixture lacks independent variation?

estimands.description: Ordinal association for native-script match in the fully synthetic engineering fixture.

inclusion_rules: Schema-valid records with data_origin=synthetic and a non-missing response.
Exactly one row per participant, stimulus and questionnaire item.
exclusion_rules: Never combine synthetic and real records in one run.

model.formula: aesthetic ~ stimulus_script * native_script + participant and stimulus hierarchy
model.fixture_approximation: Ordered fixed-effect contrast plus double-group holdout; crossed ordinal random effects remain required for real research.

missingness: Preserve missing and not-applicable values; never convert either to zero.
Report exclusions and missingness by native and stimulus script.
multiple_comparisons: Holm correction within each declared outcome family.
sensitivity: Continuous HC3 approximation is labeled sensitivity-only.
Repeat feature checks by frozen representation and profile without outcome-driven selection.
stopping_rule: The deterministic fixture uses all generated rows; real-data stopping requires GATE-PARTICIPANTS approval.
output_boundaries: All results are SYNTHETIC / DEMO and cannot support a scientific conclusion.
WP2 remains a context/hypothesis link and is never assigned as participant exposure.
WP4 remains instance-level until independent exemplar and expert gates pass.
